requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The out-of-box experience (OOBE) for 123.hp.com must use a single, consistent product name/reference for the HP OfficeJet Pro 9010 series to minimize user confusion and errors.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must be capable of reliably printing on all new and current EM (Evaluation Media) and market segment media types, meeting intervention and print quality requirements under various climatic conditions for the Manhattan platform.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must operate normally and without hardware failures (e.g., input tray sensor flag breakage) when placed on uneven surfaces such as sofas, table cloths, or carpets.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Assess whether the printer experiences any functional failure when tilted 20 degrees left or right during printing.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must maintain print quality and functionality when printing while placed on a moving trolley.
